title: Least-Squares State Estimation, LQR and LQ-Tracking
summary: This note is a tutorial on the Least-Squares State Estimator (LSSE) (the deterministic version of the Kalman-Bucy filter) and related topics. The LSSE is formulated as finding the state trajectory consistent with the system's equations with the minimal amount of L2 process and measurement uncertainty. As stated, this is an input-signal design problem with linear dynamics and affine-quadratic objective in the state and inputs, and therefore a deterministic optimal control problem.
